item.description:
Dax 3.9.11

  • Talk to your agents from your iPhone. Dax Companion 1.6 listens, tidies what you said and sends it to the agent you picked. Your Mac goes quiet while you speak.
  • Watch your Mac’s browser on the phone as live video. Tap and scroll it, or type into it. Switch to Reader for the phone’s own copy of the page.
  • Hold an agent on the phone to bring its pane forward on the Mac. Close it, or speak a prompt to it, from the same menu.
  • Agents can show you a file on a card with Quick View: an email draft, a diff, a PDF or pictures. Answer with a button. Pinch to zoom any card.
  • The File Drawer is now the Shelf. Clips, Indicators and the AI Video queue moved into the Drawer at the foot of the sidebar. Clips play one at a time, and you swipe through them.
  • Dax frees space from old worktrees on its own and tells you how much it freed.
  • The phone lists every project your Mac has worked in. It also shows the AI Video queue, with Stop and Clear.
  • Schedules run without asking for permission unless you pick otherwise. ⌘⇧-clicking a link asks where to open it when a browser is already up.
